verdict.rationale: Aider is itself an official command-line tool. It has documented installers (pip `aider-install` and a curl script), files passed on the command line, many CLI switches that can also be set via `.aider.conf.yml` or `AIDER_xxx` env vars, and a non-interactive `--message` mode for scripting. Community users describe running it both interactively and scripted from the command line. Missing for 10: no documented structured or machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output mode for agentic pipelines.
